```{r}

#sunburst plot to show assay type, model system, and gene combinations

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggforce)
library(extrafont)
library(grid)

loadfonts(device = 'all')

# Case-insensitive normalization ("Cell Fitness" / "Cell fitness" -> same
# group) -- Supplementary_Data_3.xlsx has occasional per-row casing
# inconsistencies in free-text columns like Assay Type (e.g.
# BRCA2_Huang_2025_SGE's "Cell Fitness" vs. every other row's "Cell
# fitness"), which would otherwise become a stray near-duplicate wedge. Named
# distinctly from sunburst_calibrated.R's own to_sentence_case() (which only
# capitalizes the first letter, leaving the rest as-is, for display only) --
# this one fully normalizes case for *grouping* correctness, sourced into a
# separate environment so the two never collide.
normalize_case <- function(x) paste0(toupper(substr(x, 1, 1)), tolower(substr(x, 2, nchar(x))))

# Derived from data/input/maves/Supplementary_Data_3.xlsx's "Curation" sheet
# (one row per MAVE dataset) -- the MAVE_curation_v3_figures.csv this chunk
# originally read was never checked into the repo. Column mapping:
# "Dataset Name" -> Dataset_tag, "Broad Disease Category" -> Disease,
# "Assay Type" -> Assay.Type, "Model System" -> Model_system, "Gene" ->
# Gene..HGNC.symbol. (kept as one row/leaf for the one multi-gene dataset,
# CALM1_CALM2_CALM3_Weile_2017, labeled "CALM1,2,3" rather than split into
# three separate gene leaves).
curation <- read_excel(
  "../../../data/input/maves/Supplementary_Data_3.xlsx",
  sheet = "Curation"
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Dataset Name`)) %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = if_else(Gene == "CALM1, CALM2, CALM3", "CALM1,2,3", Gene),
    `Assay Type` = normalize_case(`Assay Type`),
    `Model System` = normalize_case(`Model System`)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Dataset_tag = `Dataset Name`,
    Disease = `Broad Disease Category`,
    Assay.Type = `Assay Type`,
    Model_system = `Model System`,
    Gene..HGNC.symbol. = Gene
  )

# Previously filtered to a hardcoded 83-dataset snapshot (pillar_project_datasets)
# that predated 8 datasets since added to the curation sheet -- including all
# 3 LDLR datasets, which is why LDLR was missing from this plot. Derived
# dynamically from the curation sheet itself instead (every dataset in
# Supplementary_Data_3.xlsx, same source src/build_figure3_data.py's Figure3c
# panel already uses), so newly-added datasets show up here automatically.
curation <- curation %>%
  filter(
    # Compared against normalize_case()'s own output (rest-of-string
    # lowercased), matching how Assay.Type/Model_system were normalized above.
    Assay.Type != normalize_case("Not Applicable (trained predictor)"),
    Disease != "None",
    Model_system != normalize_case("Not Applicable")
  )

# Calibrated (exact print-size) rendering -- see
# src/lib/figures/sunburst_calibrated.R for the geometry/text-fit logic.
# Sourced into its own env (matching Figure5_6.Rmd/Extended_data_figures.Rmd's
# convention for three_ring_donut.R et al.) so its constants (FONT_FAMILY,
# LABEL_PT, ...) can't collide with another calibrated lib sourced later in
# this document.
.sunburst_lib <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
source("../../../src/lib/figures/sunburst_calibrated.R", local = .sunburst_lib)
plot_sunburst_calibrated <- .sunburst_lib$plot_sunburst_calibrated

gene_rows <- curation %>% rename(Gene = Gene..HGNC.symbol.)

# 3.6in diameter, matching the published figure.
sunburst <- plot_sunburst_calibrated(gene_rows, diameter_mm = 3.6 * 25.4)

sunburst$plot

ggsave(
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "sunburst_calibrated.pdf"),
  sunburst$plot,
  width = sunburst$width_mm, height = sunburst$height_mm, units = 'mm',
  device = cairo_pdf, create.dir = TRUE
)

```

```{r}
#Figure 2C, variant effect measurements
# Rebuild via `poetry run python -m src.build_figure3_data` -- see
# docs/build_figure3_data.md.

tested = read.csv(file.path(INTERMEDIATE_DIR, "Figure3c.csv.gz"))

# Figure3c.csv.gz (global variant dedup, the default/current methodology) and
# Figure3c_measurements.csv.gz (per-dataset dedup, the old/preprint
# methodology) both record which --variant-dedup-scope built them (see
# docs/build_figure3_data.md) in a variant_dedup_scope column, so each
# rendered bar chart's y-axis title always matches what's actually being
# counted: "global" counts a variant once across all of a gene's sibling
# datasets, so the total is a count of distinct variants, not of per-dataset
# measurements; "per-dataset" counts a variant once per dataset that tested
# it, so the total really is a measurement count.
bar_y_title_for_scope <- function(scope) {
  if (identical(scope, "global")) "Total unique variants" else "Total variant effect measurements"
}

# Figure3c.csv.gz's Gene column is the raw integrated-dataset value for the
# one multi-gene dataset (CALM1_CALM2_CALM3_Weile_2017); matches the
# "CALM1,2,3" label used for the same dataset in the sunburst above.
prepare_variant_bar_summary <- function(tested) {
  df2 <- tested %>%
    mutate(
      Gene = if_else(Gene == "CALM1, CALM2, CALM3", "CALM1,2,3", Gene),
      assay_type = case_when(
        SGE == "Yes"  ~ "SGE",
        Vamp == "Yes" ~ "VAMP",
        TRUE          ~ "Other"
      )
    )

  summary_df <- df2 %>%
    group_by(Gene, assay_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_variants = sum(n_unique_IDs, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  gene_order <- summary_df %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(n_variants)) %>%
    arrange(desc(total)) %>%
    pull(Gene)

  summary_df %>% mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = gene_order))
}

# Figure3c.csv.gz's global dedup picks one surviving Dataset per variant, so
# a per-Dataset table can't reveal that a variant was actually tested by
# more than one assay type (e.g. LDLR has 16,413 variants tested by both an
# "Other" dataset and a Vamp-seq dataset). Figure3c_assay_combos.csv.gz
# tallies unique variants by the *set* of assay types that tested each one
# instead, so those variants get their own "Other+VAMP"-style combo --
# plot_variant_bar_calibrated() renders combo segments as a diagonal stripe
# rather than silently folding them into one assay type.
prepare_variant_bar_summary_from_combos <- function(combos) {
  summary_df <- combos %>%
    transmute(
      Gene = if_else(Gene == "CALM1, CALM2, CALM3", "CALM1,2,3", Gene),
      assay_type = assay_combo,
      n_variants = n_unique_IDs
    ) %>%
    group_by(Gene, assay_type) %>%
    summarise(n_variants = sum(n_variants, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  gene_order <- summary_df %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(n_variants)) %>%
    arrange(desc(total)) %>%
    pull(Gene)

  summary_df %>% mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = gene_order))
}

# Calibrated (exact print-size) rendering -- see
# src/lib/figures/variant_bar_calibrated.R for the layout logic. Sourced
# into its own env (matching the convention for every other calibrated lib
# in this document) so its constants can't collide with another one sourced
# elsewhere in this document.
.bar_lib <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
source("../../../src/lib/figures/variant_bar_calibrated.R", local = .bar_lib)
plot_variant_bar_calibrated <- .bar_lib$plot_variant_bar_calibrated

# 4.25in x 3.25in total, matching the published figure.
assay_combos <- read.csv(file.path(INTERMEDIATE_DIR, "Figure3c_assay_combos.csv.gz"))
summary_df <- prepare_variant_bar_summary_from_combos(assay_combos)
bar_chart <- plot_variant_bar_calibrated(summary_df, y_title = bar_y_title_for_scope(unique(tested$variant_dedup_scope)))

bar_chart$plot

ggsave(
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "barplot_variants_calibrated.pdf"),
  bar_chart$plot,
  width = bar_chart$width_mm, height = bar_chart$height_mm, units = 'mm',
  device = cairo_pdf, create.dir = TRUE
)

# Old/preprint methodology (per-dataset dedup), rendered for comparison --
# see docs/build_figure3_data.md's "Figure3c vs Figure3c_measurements".
tested_measurements <- read.csv(file.path(INTERMEDIATE_DIR, "Figure3c_measurements.csv.gz"))
summary_df_measurements <- prepare_variant_bar_summary(tested_measurements)
bar_chart_measurements <- plot_variant_bar_calibrated(
  summary_df_measurements,
  y_title = bar_y_title_for_scope(unique(tested_measurements$variant_dedup_scope))
)

bar_chart_measurements$plot

ggsave(
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "barplot_variants_measurements_calibrated.pdf"),
  bar_chart_measurements$plot,
  width = bar_chart_measurements$width_mm, height = bar_chart_measurements$height_mm, units = 'mm',
  device = cairo_pdf, create.dir = TRUE
)

#2C pie chart

igvf_summary <- tested %>%
  group_by(IGVF) %>%
  summarise(
    n_variants = sum(n_unique_IDs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

igvf_summary <- igvf_summary %>%
  mutate(
    pct = n_variants / sum(n_variants),
    label = scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1)
  )


IGVF_pie = ggplot(igvf_summary, aes(x = "", y = n_variants, fill = IGVF)) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    width = 1,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  coord_polar("y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Yes" = "#176082",  
      "No"  = "#D6EAEC"  
    )
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = NA),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black",
    size = 4
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(fill = "IGVF")

IGVF_pie

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "IGVF_pie_chart.png"), IGVF_pie, dpi = 300, device = 'png', height = 4, width = 4, create.dir = TRUE)

```

```{r}

#venn diagram Figure 2D
# Rebuild via `poetry run python -m src.build_figure3_data` -- see
# docs/build_figure3_data.md.

venn = read.csv(file.path(INTERMEDIATE_DIR, "Figure3d.csv.gz"))

library(eulerr)

# Collapse counts
B <- venn$Count[venn$Group == "Benign"] +
     venn$Count[venn$Group == "Likely benign"] +
     venn$Count[venn$Group == "Benign/Likely benign"]

P <- venn$Count[venn$Group == "Pathogenic"] +
     venn$Count[venn$Group == "Likely pathogenic"] +
     venn$Count[venn$Group == "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"]

G <- venn$Count[venn$Group == "gnomAD"]
D <- venn$Count[venn$Group == "Unreported_SNVs"]

BG = venn$Count.in.gnomAD[venn$Group == "Benign"] +
          venn$Count.in.gnomAD[venn$Group == "Likely benign"] +
          venn$Count.in.gnomAD[venn$Group == "Benign/Likely benign"]

PG = venn$Count.in.gnomAD[venn$Group == "Pathogenic"] +
          venn$Count.in.gnomAD[venn$Group == "Likely pathogenic"] +
          venn$Count.in.gnomAD[venn$Group == "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"]

V = venn$Count[venn$Group == "VUS total"]

VG = venn$Count.in.gnomAD[venn$Group == "VUS total"]

B_new = B - BG
P_new = P - PG
V_new = V - VG
G_new <- G - (BG+PG+VG)

# Calibrated (exact print-size) rendering -- see
# src/lib/figures/euler_venn_calibrated.R for the layout logic (circle
# geometry still comes from eulerr::euler(), same as before; only the
# rendering -- exact mm sizing, label placement/rotation/shrink-to-fit, and
# the legend -- is custom). Sourced into its own env (matching the
# convention for every other calibrated lib in this document) so its
# constants can't collide with another one sourced elsewhere in this
# document.
.venn_lib <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
source("../../../src/lib/figures/euler_venn_calibrated.R", local = .venn_lib)
plot_euler_venn_calibrated <- .venn_lib$plot_euler_venn_calibrated

# 2.4in H x 3in W total, matching the published figure.
venn_chart <- plot_euler_venn_calibrated(
  B = B_new, P = P_new, G = G_new, V = V_new, D = D, BG = BG, PG = PG, VG = VG
)

venn_chart$plot

ggsave(
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "venn_variants_calibrated.pdf"),
  venn_chart$plot,
  width = venn_chart$width_mm, height = venn_chart$height_mm, units = 'mm',
  device = cairo_pdf, create.dir = TRUE
)
```
